correctness.rationale: The primary paper's Theorem 4.2 proof was reconstructed from the displayed generator. At the AM--GM step the three factors are \(aA/S(t)\), \(b eta e^{-\lambda	au}S(t-	au)/(1+\kappa I(t-	au))\), and \(1+\kappa I(t)\), whose product contains the omitted factor \(ho(t)= rac{S(t-	au)}{S(t)} rac{1+\kappa I(t)}{1+\kappa I(t-	au)}\). The theorem's initial-history domain supplies no lower bound \(ho(t)\ge1\). For the submitted exact history, \(I(t-	au)=I(t)\), so an earlier dropped infected-state ratio in the paper is neutralized; direct rational reconstruction gives \(a=80/9\), \(b=16/3\), \(\widetilde{\mathcal R}_0^S=80/21>1\), \(\mathcal LU=2486393/90900\), and the printed state-independent post-AM--GM expression \(-8761/900\). Thus the asserted upper bound is false on an admissible positive history. The final claim correctly stops at proof failure and does not infer that the persistence theorem itself is false.
